cases.title: Chakan MIDC Industrialist Armed Ambush & Extortion Conspiracy
cases.caseType: Attempted Murder & Organized Extortion (BNS 109, 308(2), 61(2) & Arms Act 3/25)
cases.incidentLocation: Chakan MIDC Phase II, Mahalunge Road, Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune 410501
cases.summary: Armed ambush orchestrated against manufacturing unit proprietor in Chakan industrial belt. Two assailants on an unregistered motorcycle discharged live rounds targeting the victim vehicle before fleeing towards Talegaon-Chakan highway. Technical surveillance, ANPR camera network at HP Chowk & Mahalunge junction, and ballistic seizure established a premeditated extortion conspiracy masterminded over disputed industrial contracts.
cases.leadInvestigator: PI Pramod Sawant (Crime Branch Unit 3, PCPC)

cases.title: Hinjawadi IT Corridor Multi-Crore Digital Arrest & Share Trading Syndicate
cases.caseType: Organized Cyber Fraud & Extortion (BNS 318(4), 316(2), 61(2) & IT Act 66D, 43)
cases.incidentLocation: Phase 1 Tech Park, Hinjawadi, Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune 411057
cases.summary: Sophisticated international cyber syndicate executed an extortionate "digital arrest" and fraudulent institutional equity trading scheme against a senior tech executive in Hinjawadi IT Park. Perpetrators impersonated enforcement directorate and telecom officers over spoofed video calls, routing ₹4.85 Crores through 14 layered mule accounts in Gujarat and Maharashtra. PCPC Cyber Crime Squad froze ₹2.10 Crores and traced IP gateways via Telegram and VPN logs.
cases.leadInvestigator: Sr. PI Ravikiran Nale (Cyber Crime Police Station, PCPC)

cases.title: Bhosari MIDC Scrap Merchant Abduction & Armed Ransom Demand
cases.caseType: Kidnapping for Ransom & Armed Dacoity (BNS 140(2), 310(2), 115(2) & MCOCA)
cases.incidentLocation: Sector 7, Bhosari MIDC, Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune 411026
cases.summary: A scrap merchant was intercepted and abducted at gunpoint by members of a local organized crime syndicate in Bhosari MIDC. The perpetrators demanded ₹50 Lakhs ransom via encrypted calls. PCPC Anti-Extortion Cell mobilized technical cell tracking on tower triangulation between Moshi and Alandi, rescuing the victim safely within 14 hours and impounding the getaway Mahindra Scorpio and illegal country-made firearms.

cases.title: Kudalwadi Commercial Bank ATM Gas-Cutter Breach & Arson Heist
cases.caseType: Commercial Burglary & Mischief by Fire (BNS 305, 331(4), 326(f) & Damage to Public Property Act)
cases.incidentLocation: Kudalwadi Main Chowk, Chikhali, Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune 411062
cases.summary: Inter-state gang utilized industrial oxy-acetylene gas cutters to breach the cash vault of an HDFC Bank ATM booth in Kudalwadi, Chikhali. Intense flame triggered currency combustion and secondary fire destroying ₹18.5 Lakhs in cash cassette assemblies. Forensics retrieved discarded oxygen cylinders, CCTV sensor spray paint residue, and tyre tread impressions matching a Bolero pickup tracked across Chakan-Nashik highway.
cases.leadInvestigator: Sr. PI Dnyaneshwar Katkar (Chikhali PS, PCPC)

cases.title: Armed Vault Breach & Digital Access Bypass at Kothari Jewellers
cases.caseType: Commercial Dacoity & Digital Bypass (BNS 309(4), 310(2), 61(2) & IT Act 66C)
cases.incidentLocation: Kothari Jewellers & Vault Facility, Datta Mandir Road, Wakad, Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune 411057
cases.summary: Vault safe room breached resulting in theft of certified diamonds and 24K bullion valued at ₹4.62 Crores. Rear service entrance (Door 2B) disarmed via valid PIN #7291 at 22:18 IST followed by manual siren relay cutoff. Multiple critical discrepancies detected: primary suspect Sachin Gaikwad claimed dining at Govind Garden, Pimple Saudagar between 21:15 and 23:00, but Jio cellular mast logs (Cell ID 404-869-38291 Wakad) and PCMC Smart City ANPR cameras (Dange Chowk & Bhumkar Chowk) prove his active presence within 280m of the crime scene.
cases.leadInvestigator: Sr. PI Vitthal More (Badge #MH-PCPC-4412, Wakad PS)

FIRST INFORMATION REPORT (Under Section 154 Cr.P.C. / BNSS)
Police Station: Wakad | Commissionerate: Pimpri Chinchwad Police (PCPC) | FIR No: 0389/2025 | Date: 25-Oct-2025
Complainant: Rajesh Nemichand Kothari (Age 52), Resident of Kaspate Vasti, Wakad.
Business: Kothari Jewellers, Plot 14, Datta Mandir Road, Wakad, Pimpri Chinchwad.

Statement of Complainant:
"On the morning of 25th October 2025 at 06:15 hours, during daily morning prayer and shutter opening, the supervisor found the heavy vault safe door wide open. Safe Locker #4 containing certified loose diamonds and hallmarked wedding jewellery worth ₹4.62 Crores had been cleared out. There are no signs of lock breaking, cutter marks, or exterior shutter tampering. The rear service gate (Door 2B facing Datta Mandir back lane) electronic keypad was unlocked using valid credential PIN 7291 at 22:18 hours on 24-Oct-2025. Only two individuals possessed this confidential emergency master code: myself and Store Operations Manager Sachin Gaikwad."

claims.text: Vault locker #4 was looted without any physical cutter or pry marks on exterior shutters.
Only Rajesh Kothari and Sachin Gaikwad held the secret emergency PIN 7291 for Door 2B.

evidence.extractedText:
WAKAD POLICE STATION, PIMPRI CHINCHWAD POLICE COMMISSIONERATE
TRANSCRIPTION OF ACCUSED INTERROGATION (AUDIO-VIDEO RECORDED)
Interrogator: Sr. PI Vitthal More | Interrogatee: Sachin Suresh Gaikwad

Q: Where were you between 21:30 and 23:00 on Friday night?
A: I was having dinner with Vikram at Govind Garden Restaurant in Pimple Saudagar. We arrived at 21:15 and left after 22:45. I never went anywhere near Wakad.
Q: Why did your phone ping on the Datta Mandir cell tower in Wakad at 22:19?
A: That must be a network glitch by Jio. Sometimes the tower signals from Wakad reach across the river to Pimple Saudagar.
Q: Did you speak to Nilesh Shinde on Friday night?
A: No, I haven't talked to Nilesh since he was fired six months ago.
Q: PCMC ANPR cameras captured your white Creta MH-14-GX-8842 crossing Dange Chowk at 22:36. Who was driving?
A: My car was parked in my apartment basement. Nobody had the keys.

claims.text: Sachin Gaikwad denied placing any call to Nilesh Shinde on the night of the incident.
Sachin Gaikwad maintained his car MH-14-GX-8842 was untouched in his basement all night.

contradictions.title: Critical Alibi Clash: Sworn Dining Claim vs Wakad Cell Tower CDR Ping

claimA.evidenceTitle: Sworn Witness Statement of Vikram Patwardhan (Sec 161 CrPC)
claimA.excerpt: “We ordered starters and main course and were seated continuously inside Govind Garden Restaurant, Pimple Saudagar from 21:20 to 22:45 hours.”

claimB.evidenceTitle: Reliance Jio Cellular Tower CDR & Cell ID Mast Records
claimB.excerpt: “22:19:34 IST: Active 4G Data Packet & SMS Delivery on Tower Wakad Datta Mandir (CellID: 404-869-38291). Signal -72dBm (~250m from vault).”

contradictions.explanation: Govind Garden in Pimple Saudagar and Kothari Jewellers on Datta Mandir Road, Wakad are separated by 6.8 kilometers (approx. 20–25 minutes driving time in Friday night traffic across the Mula river). An individual cannot be seated continuously inside a restaurant in Pimple Saudagar at 22:19 while their handset exchanges packet data via the Datta Mandir Wakad mast with a -72dBm signal.
alternativeExplanations: Handset was carried by an accomplice while Gaikwad remained at the restaurant (requires interrogating Vikram Patwardhan on whether Gaikwad had his phone in hand).
Tower overshoot/reflection anomaly across the river (highly improbable given -72dBm direct line-of-sight signal strength).
suggestedVerificationSteps: Subpoena CCTV DVR from Govind Garden Restaurant cashier and dining area for 24-Oct-2025 (21:00 to 23:00).
Examine UPI / credit card payment slips for food billing at Govind Garden to establish exact payer identity.
Check cell tower antenna azimuth and sector coverage angles for Wakad Datta Mandir Tower 404-869-38291.
contradictions.investigatorNotes: Sr. PI Vitthal More: Subpoena served on Govind Garden owner. Cashier states only Vikram was seated in AC room; second patron left abruptly at 21:35.

contradictions.title: Vehicle Mobility Contradiction: Creta MH-14-GX-8842 Basement Claim vs Dange Chowk ANPR

claimA.evidenceTitle: Interrogation Transcription of Sachin Gaikwad (Wakad PS)
claimA.excerpt: “My white Creta (MH-14-GX-8842) was parked in my apartment basement in Pimple Saudagar all night. Nobody had the keys.”

claimB.evidenceTitle: PCMC Smart City ANPR & ICCC Nigdi Optical Camera Feed Log
claimB.excerpt: “22:36:12 IST: Plate MH-14-GX-8842 (White Hyundai Creta) captured moving westbound past Dange Chowk Pole #WK-44 towards Hinjawadi. Driver wearing blue collared shirt.”
claimB.location: Dange Chowk Junction Smart City Pole #WK-44

contradictions.explanation: Gaikwad asserts under interrogation that his vehicle remained stationary in Royal Palms basement slot B-14. However, PCMC Smart City high-speed ANPR camera Pole #WK-44 at Dange Chowk recorded plate MH-14-GX-8842 transiting at 22:36:12, followed by NHAI FASTag electronic toll clearance at Somatane Toll Plaza at 23:14:22 heading toward Mumbai.
alternativeExplanations: Cloned or counterfeit number plate on identical white Creta (unlikely given matching aftermarket black roof rails and alloy wheels photographed at Somatane).
Vehicle was taken by a third party without Gaikwad’s knowledge.
suggestedVerificationSteps: Retrieve Royal Palms society gate security boom-barrier logs and basement CCTV for egress timestamp.
Requisition high-resolution facial crop from Somatane Toll Plaza Lane 04 optical camera.
Impound vehicle MH-14-GX-8842 upon intercept and swab steering wheel / gear lever for DNA.
contradictions.investigatorNotes: API Sagar Patil: Royal Palms security log confirms Creta MH-14-GX-8842 exited basement gate at 21:38. Gaikwad’s claim is demonstrably false.

contradictions.title: Suspect Denies Accomplice Contact vs CDR 38-Second Voice Call

claimA.evidenceTitle: Interrogation Transcription of Sachin Gaikwad (Wakad PS)
claimA.excerpt: “No, I haven’t talked to Nilesh Shinde since he was fired from the store six months ago.”

claimB.evidenceTitle: Reliance Jio Cellular Tower CDR & Cell ID Mast Records
claimB.excerpt: “22:24:05 IST: Outgoing voice call (duration: 38 sec) from Gaikwad to +91-97640-11209 (Nilesh Baban Shinde) connected via Wakad Tower.”

contradictions.explanation: Gaikwad categorically denies any communication with ex-guard Nilesh Shinde, but telecommunication CDR confirms a connected 38-second conversation initiated six minutes after Door 2B was unlocked. FSL Pune subsequently identified Shinde’s latent fingerprints on the safe box.
alternativeExplanations: Accidental pocket dial that rang and connected to voicemail (contradicted by 38-second active two-way voice duration).
suggestedVerificationSteps: Obtain tower location of Nilesh Shinde’s phone (+91-97640-11209) at 22:24 to confirm if he was already inside or near the shop.
Execute raid on Nilesh Shinde’s residence near Indrayani Nagar, Bhosari MIDC.
contradictions.investigatorNotes: Crime Branch Unit 2 dispatched to Bhosari MIDC. Nilesh Shinde detained with Yamaha motorcycle and black rucksack.

contradictions.title: Keypad Bypass Knowledge: Exclusive Access Claim vs OmniLock First-Try Entry

claimA.evidenceTitle: First Information Report (FIR No. 0389/2025, Wakad PS)
claimA.excerpt: “Only two individuals possessed this confidential emergency master code: myself and Store Operations Manager Sachin Gaikwad.”

claimB.evidenceTitle: OmniLock Digital Keypad EEPROM Controller Dump
claimB.excerpt: “22:18:02 IST: EMERGENCY PIN ENTRY [#7291] - MATCH CONFIRMED. No brute-force invalid code attempts registered.”

contradictions.explanation: If Rajesh Kothari was at the Rotary dinner in Hinjawadi and Gaikwad was the only other codeholder, either Gaikwad operated the keypad or leaked PIN #7291 to accomplices. The lack of any failed trial attempts indicates exact knowledge of the PIN.
alternativeExplanations: PIN #7291 was known to third-party keypad maintenance engineers or previous staff.
Keypad was compromised via optical hidden camera or hardware skimmer.
suggestedVerificationSteps: Audit installer logs from Godrej / OmniLock Pune Regional Office (Shivajinagar).
Check keypad housing for micro-drills, taps, or skimmer implants.
contradictions.investigatorNotes: Hardware examination complete: no skimmer found. Code was entered directly by authorized possessor.

gaps.title: Unaccounted 22-Minute Window Between Dange Chowk and Bhumkar Chowk for Creta MH-14-GX-8842
gaps.description: ANPR Camera Pole #WK-44 at Dange Chowk captured Creta MH-14-GX-8842 at 22:36:12. The vehicle was next recorded at Bhumkar Chowk at 22:58:40. Standard transit duration between these two points via Hinjawadi Flyover is 6 to 8 minutes. 14 to 16 minutes remain unexplained.
gaps.whyItMatters: During this unaccounted window, stolen jewellery could have been offloaded to an accomplice or transferred to another vehicle in Hinjawadi Phase 1 or Tathawade.
gaps.whatIsUnknown: Exact route and intermediate stops taken by the vehicle between Dange Chowk and Bhumkar Chowk.
gaps.suggestedNextStep: Pull private commercial CCTV from petrol pumps and hotels along Tathawade / Dange Chowk BRTS road (HP Petrol Pump & Ginger Hotel junction).

gaps.title: Unidentified Pillion Rider on Yamaha FZ (MH-14-FA-5120) heading toward Hinjawadi Phase 2
gaps.description: Traffic camera near Bhumkar Chowk captured Yamaha motorcycle MH-14-FA-5120 (registered to Nilesh Shinde) carrying a pillion rider holding a dark rucksack at 22:42. Both riders were wearing helmets with tinted visors.
gaps.whyItMatters: The pillion rider may be the primary handler transporting the stolen diamonds away from the getaway car.
gaps.whatIsUnknown: Identity of the pillion rider on motorcycle MH-14-FA-5120.
gaps.suggestedNextStep: Check CCTV cameras along Hinjawadi Phase 2 Ring Road and Megapolis circle for motorcycle stops or helmet removal.

gaps.title: Installer Provisioning & Default PIN Audit from OmniLock Pune Regional Office
gaps.description: Complainant claimed only he and Gaikwad held PIN #7291. It has not yet been verified whether the security installer changed the master code upon commissioning or if it was recorded in vendor service logs.
gaps.whyItMatters: If the PIN was known to security contractors or technicians, an external actor could have entered without Gaikwad’s active collusion.
gaps.whatIsUnknown: Original setup date and service engineer records for OmniLock keypad installation at Kothari Jewellers.
gaps.suggestedNextStep: Serve notice under Section 91 Cr.P.C. / BNSS to OmniLock security vendor (Shivajinagar, Pune) for complete installation and technician logs.

gaps.title: Missing Rear Alley CCTV Feed Behind Datta Mandir Road Arcade
gaps.description: The municipal smart city CCTV pole WK-42 covering Datta Mandir back lane was out of order due to road trenching work by PCMC water supply department on 24-Oct.
gaps.whyItMatters: There is no direct governmental optical recording of the physical ingress at Door 2B between 22:15 and 22:35.
gaps.whatIsUnknown: Exact physical count and facial appearance of individuals entering Door 2B.
gaps.suggestedNextStep: Seize standalone private CCTV hard drives from neighbouring Apollo Pharmacy and Shriram Sweet Mart rear corridors.

gaps.title: Trace end-beneficiary crypto conversion off-ramps
gaps.description: Outflow analysis indicates ₹2.75 Crores converted into USDT on P2P trading platforms.
gaps.whyItMatters: Locating the off-ramps is required to issue freezing orders and identify syndicate handlers.
gaps.whatIsUnknown: Wallet addresses used for the final P2P fiat conversion.
gaps.suggestedNextStep: Issue 91 CrPC / BNSS 94 notice to Binance/WazirX compliance desks for KYC on flagged transaction hashes.

gaps.title: Toll plaza FASTag lookup for Bolero pickup
gaps.description: Getaway vehicle tyre impressions match Bolero camper pickup heading north towards Nashik.
gaps.whyItMatters: FASTag capture confirms vehicle registration and syndicate interstate transit origin.
gaps.whatIsUnknown: FASTag tag ID at Moshi and Chandoli toll plazas during 03:30 - 05:00 AM window.
gaps.suggestedNextStep: Subpoena IHMCL server logs for Chandoli Toll Plaza on NH-60 for matching vehicle class.
